title: 最後一球灰藍線
subject: two strangers reach on a Saturday for the very last ball of grey-blue wool of the same dye lot in a Beipu wool shop; the shop auntie winds it into two balls so they each knit half, and the two scarves match
caption: Hakka mountain-song (shange) pop, mid-tempo 4/4 with call-and-response phrasing and a Taiwan hill-town wool-shop setting. bamboo dizi carrying a bright rising-and-falling shange melody, Hakka suona answering in short phrases, steel-string acoustic guitar strumming steady eighth notes, small gong and wooden clapper keeping a light two-beat, upright bass on the roots. dry close-miked acoustic mix with a little room reverb, hillside-village feel, no big drums. female lead with a male voice answering each phrase in call-and-response, bright open mid-register, folk-singing delivery, clearly sung. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 96 BPM, G major. warm, teasing, sweet mood. No rap, no autotune, no electronic drums, no synth pads, no electric guitar solos, no EDM drop.
lyrics:
[Intro - dizi and suona answering over light guitar]

[Verse 1]
星期六 北埔 毛線店
我伸手去拿 最後一球
灰藍色 同一缸染的
有隻手 比我早一點點

[Pre-Chorus]
兩個人 都不放手
阿姨笑 拿出了剪刀

[Chorus]
一球線 分成兩球
你一半 我一半
你織你的 我織我的
織出來 看看一樣不一樣

[Verse 2]
阿姨坐下來 慢慢繞線
繞一圈 問一句 你住哪裡
他說竹東 我說新埔
線繞完了 話也繞完了

[Chorus]
一球線 分成兩球
你一半 我一半
你織你的 我織我的
織出來 領口一樣不一樣

[Bridge - dizi alone, then guitar]
我織得緊 他織得鬆
灰藍的線 不管這些

[Chorus]
一球線 分成兩球
你一半 我一半
下個禮拜六 再來店裡
兩條圍巾 擺在一起看

[Outro - suona and dizi, slowing]
阿姨說 還有一球 剛到貨
